title: Capstone Journey: Correcting Session Attendance
overview: Cross-tool journey transforming a vague stakeholder complaint into a reviewed requirement, a complete decision table, a traceable evidence graph, and analyzing a late-reporting policy change.

parts.prompt: Stakeholder complaint: 'We need staff to be able to fix attendance after a session is completed.'
parts.task: Identify ambiguities (who counts as staff, what modal obligation, what reporting period boundaries) and produce a structured EARS requirement statement.

parts.prompt: The single sentence does not define behavior for School Staff, Volunteers, Cancelled sessions, or Locked reporting periods.
parts.task: Complete the 18-combination rule space, mark impossible combinations, and export Gherkin acceptance scenarios.

parts.prompt: Connect REQ-ATT-001 and its acceptance scenarios to upstream goals, architectural decisions, components, and metrics.
parts.task: Map the 30-node Pathways graph connecting Goal -> Need -> Req -> Decision -> Test -> Metric.

parts.prompt: Change Event: 'Pathways events sometimes submit attendance 2 weeks after the reporting period is locked.'
parts.task: Run BFS impact simulation on REQ-ATT-001 to identify all downstream tests, components, and metrics affected by changing the period lock policy.
